review is because of the receptionist and not the doctor. Dr. Fullerton (apologies if spelling is incorrect) was kind, patient and understanding during the consultation.

When I registered with the GP, I read through all the reviews first and was aware of the patient complaints against the receptionist. I just thought they were disgruntled patients.
I was wrong.

The receptionist booked me on the wrong date, even though I confirmed it multiple times when I called. She booked me for a week after my requested date and conveyed the wrong date and even confirmed it with me. So I walk in today morning at the given time and I get told that it's next Thursday, not today. So whoever booked my appointment on the system clearly didn't book the right date and gave me the wrong information multiple times.
